recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is appropriate for FHIR-12567; any future Goal relationship extension wording cleanup should be evaluated in the FHIR Extension Pack and against FHIR-36774 rather than by restoring `milestone` in core.
issue_request: FHIR-12567 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 Patient Care and asked to rename the `component` code to `milestone` within `valueset-goal-relationship-type`.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 7b13414b9f6d008c7a0227695ce0b75979e7e7e5 applied FHIR-12567 in the old Goal extensions spreadsheet and sheet text by changing `component` to `milestone`. Later commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced split Goal relationship CodeSystem and ValueSet source that still contained `milestone`, confirming the rename survived the source rework.
additional_context: FHIR-11174 records the earlier Goal.milestone need and the pre-seed `component` relationship type. FHIR-36774 later superseded the seed terminology by removing ambiguous `milestone` and adding `part-of`, applied in commit 73d9e9d33454c7b4edbcc119c589bb028777ca39. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 then removed the Goal relationship extension, ValueSet, and CodeSystem from core source during the R5 extension move. The current core checkout only retains generic Goal resource entries and OID records for these canonicals; the FHIR Extension Pack contains the current CodeSystem and ValueSet with `part-of` and no `component` or `milestone`. FHIR-36774 already has a combined-branch audit commit, so it was not duplicated.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Restoring `milestone` would conflict with the later FHIR-36774 decision, and editing core would not affect the current authoritative artifact because it has moved to the FHIR Extension Pack.
